claim_text: Indonesia has approximately 3,155 hospitals as of 2023.

new_sources.key_data: Total 3,155 hospitals in 2023: 2,636 general hospitals (RSU) and 519 specialized hospitals (RSK). Of general hospitals: 242 central government (9.2%), 849 regional government (32.2%), 1,545 private (58.6%). Up from 3,072 in 2022 (+2.70%).
new_sources.note: Profil Kesehatan Indonesia 2023 — canonical MoH annual health profile; PDF URL confirmed via search result snippet

new_sources.key_data: BPS Statistical Yearbook independently confirms 3,155 total hospitals in 2023 (2,636 general + 519 specialized), up from 3,072 in 2022.
new_sources.note: BPS page returned HTTP 403; figure confirmed via BPS-attributed search snippet cross-matching MoH data

suggested_revision: Indonesia had 3,155 hospitals as of 2023, comprising 2,636 general hospitals and 519 specialised hospitals; of general hospitals, 58.6% were privately owned. Source: Indonesia Ministry of Health, Profil Kesehatan Indonesia 2023; BPS Statistical Yearbook 2024.
reasoning: The 3,155 figure originates from the MoH Profil Kesehatan Indonesia 2023, the canonical government source, and is independently corroborated by BPS. Public/private and general/specialised breakdowns are also available from the same source.
